exclusion_detail: Lead D-chiro-inositol ribophostin 10 needs the protected inositol triflate 11 (from racemic myo-inositol bisketal PMB ether via diastereomeric camphanate esters, separation, hydrolysis and triflation), the protected ribose 12, the NaH coupling to 13, trans-ketal removal, monobenzylation (15/16 separation), PMB removal, phosphitylation/oxidation (17 to 19) and global deprotection: well over 4 reactions (roughly 10 or more even with 11 and 12 counted as one step each from the paper's own sequence).

lead.why: Abstract/title: 'D-chiro-Inositol ribophostin 10 was synthesized ...'; 'D-chiro-Inositol ribophostin is the most potent small-molecule Ins(1,4,5)P3 receptor agonist without a nucleobase yet synthesized.'

notes: Only one target (10) plus intermediates; every other compound in the paper is an intermediate of the same long sequence. No SI file in the bundle.
